defects.evidence: These bullets are too vague: - “Responsible for...”
“Model performance” could mean accuracy, latency, throughput, or cost, so name the metric.
Delete: > Single-handedly built the company’s entire ML platform used by every team. “Single-handedly” and “entire” sound exaggerated.
Delete this Mobility bullet because the previous bullet already says the same thing with metrics.
Delete this Research-Agent bullet: > Leveraged cutting-edge AI synergies to drive innovation across the organization. It is generic and provides no evidence.
Avoid first person: replace “I worked on” with a direct action verb.
Put experience in reverse chronological order. Mobility Systems Company should appear before Eastern Robotics.
Use past tense for completed internships: “Built,” not “Builds.”
